title: Internals, Cluster & Repository Management
prereqs: Comfort with kubectl + docker exec into nodes
description: Under the hood and in the operator's seat: control-plane architecture, the scheduler, CNI/CRI, etcd internals + backup/restore, API aggregation, CRDs & operators, and admission webhooks — plus the operational craft of cluster lifecycle (kubeadm upgrades, node cordon/drain, multi-cluster contexts) and repository management (container registries, Helm chart repos, and GitOps repo structure). Heavy on debugging real failures.
